create_standard_fp16_loss_scaler: create a StandardFloat16LossScaler with custom init_scale and scale_window for FP16 training
run_optimizer_step_with_scaler: run an optimizer step using Float16LossScaler to get scaled gradient results
unscale_gradients_before_clipping: unscale optimizer gradients using the loss scaler before gradient clipping
